title: Community Parking Rules — Enforcement, Towing and Fines on the Parking License
content:
Enforcement under the Parking License escalates per plate over the trailing 365 days.

## Rules

**R1 — The enforcement record.** The record that decides a violation covers the trailing 365 calendar days ending on and including the date of the violation being decided. It counts, separately, the warnings and the fines recorded in that window on the license, and on any license of the same lease for the same plate.

**R2 — Tow on first occurrence.** A violation whose code is one of the product's tow-on-first-occurrence codes is towed on its first occurrence.

**R3 — Inoperable and abandoned vehicles.** An inoperable or abandoned vehicle (one left unmoved for the product's abandoned-vehicle days) is towed only after a notice has been posted on it for the product's tow-notice hours.

**R4 — Items in the space.** Storing household items in a space is a wrong-space violation unless the product allows storage in the space.

**R5 — Towing charges.** Tow and storage charges are billed by the towing company to the vehicle owner and never appear on a Larkspur ledger.

**R6 — One fine per violation.** Only one fine is billed for a given violation. A violation that already has a fine line billed for it receives no second fine.

## The 365-day window illustrated (hypothetical dates)

A violation decided on 10 June of a non-leap year looks back over 10 June itself and the 364 days before it, so the window opens on 11 June of the previous year. A warning recorded on 11 June of the previous year is inside the window; one recorded on 10 June of the previous year is outside it.

| Record | Same license | Other license of the same lease, same plate | Other license of the same lease, different plate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Counted in the window | yes | yes | no |

## Retired clause

*Retired:* "Any other violation is a warning while fewer than the product's warnings-before-fine are on record, then a fine of the product's violation fine amount while fewer than the product's fines-before-tow are on record, and then a tow." This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current violation fine schedule.

superseded_clauses: Any other violation is a warning while fewer than warnings_before_fine warnings are on record, then a fine of violation_fine_amount while fewer than fines_before_tow fines are on record, and then a tow.
